title: Constant-scalar tensor comparison commutes with pro-etale inverse image
statement: Let R be a finite commutative ring, p:X→Y any scheme morphism, and aX,aY the representative-normalized unbounded intrinsic tensor models [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Write EX,EY for the specified associated-module-sheaf derived equivalences [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let alpha: EY.functor ⋙ Lp_intrinsic^* ≅ Lp_fixed^* ⋙ EX.functor be the inverse mate of the constant-section-normalized right derived direct-image comparison, after identifying the two intrinsic direct-image presentations by the coefficient Hom bijection [lem-stage3-inverse-mate-equivalences]. There exist natural tensor isomorphisms tX:EX(M tensor_fixed N)≅aX(EX(M),EX(N)) and tY analogously, such that alpha, the published fixed-scalar inverse-image tensor comparison, and the canonical intrinsic inverse-image tensor comparison satisfy ComparisonCompatible [lem-sp-categorical-projection-mate-square]. This asserts only tensor and inverse-image compatibility, for all unbounded pairs; no projection map or its invertibility occurs.

source.place: Tags 07A4 (lemma-pullback-tensor-product) and 07A6 (lemma-adjoint); constant-scalar tensor square in step 1 of lem-sf-finite-scalar-proper-projection-presentation

proof.text: Construct tX and tY from the unique normalized single-site tensor realization, whose ordinary and signed-total tensor maps and descent are proved.
Write the two sides of ComparisonCompatible as natural transformations on the product of fixed derived categories. The representative square identifies their components at flat-term K-flat pairs.

Resolve each of two arbitrary derived objects by a flat-term K-flat complex. Naturality along the resulting pair of localization isomorphisms and cancellation transfer the representative equation to that pair. Natural transformation extensionality and currying give ComparisonCompatible for all inputs.

proof_origin.place: Tag 07A4: construct each tensor realization and reduce the inverse-image square to resolving pairs; extend to all derived inputs by naturality along flat K-flat resolutions.

theorem finiteScalarTensorPullbackComparison
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Finite R]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ Y)
    (aX : ProEtaleTensorModel X (proEtaleConstantRing X R))
    (aY : ProEtaleTensorModel Y (proEtaleConstantRing Y R)) :
    ∃ (tX : (postcompose₂.obj (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X R).functor).obj
          (ProEtale.derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) X) ≅
        (((whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X R).functor).obj
          (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X R).functor).obj (curry.obj aX.tensor))
      (tY : (postcompose₂.obj (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y R).functor).obj
          (ProEtale.derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) Y) ≅
        (((whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y R).functor).obj
          (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence Y R).functor).obj (curry.obj aY.tensor)),
      Adjunction.ComparisonCompatible (finiteScalarPullbackComparison R p)
        (ProEtale.leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} R)) p)
        (finiteScalarCurriedTensorPullback R p aX aY) tX tY
